items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Grachan Moncure the second on bass, and Cozy and Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: Well actually, let's go back to January. Let's see -- yeah, January 1936. January 30th.
Teddy Wilson and his orchestra, Gordon Griffin, trumpet, Rudy Powell, yourself, Teddy, John True hart again, Grachan Moncure the second on bass, and Cozy and Billie Holiday.
That's Life Begins When You're In Love, 'which is a vocal by Billie Holiday. And then, If I Had Rhythm In My Nursery Rhymes.'
